messages:
sara: ran into noisy failure when running `./bin/eval-runner local --config test.yaml` — validator throws `Unexpected key: 'eval_timeout'` and exits.
ben: that's the strict schema validator from #PR-2134; it was meant to prevent silent typos but we made it the default.
iqra: can we change UX to warn locally? dev loop is slower when you have to revert small typos.
ben: yeah we can. Proposal: default warn for local runs, error in CI. Add `--strict` to opt-in and `--strict=ci` for CI-only enforcement.
sara: +1. Also the stderr output is huge. Can we add suggested fix lines e.g., "did you mean 'timeout'?" ?
dave: we already have a suggestions map for common typos in model.yaml. Should plug it into the validator.
ml-ops: note: CI currently checks `exit_code != 0` to fail the job. If validator changed semantics CI needs updating.
ci-bot: build 4728 — failed in eval-harness preflight: exit 2 — see logs: https://ci.redwood/4728/logs
iqra: suggested UX: `eval-runner preflight --mode=warn|error --format=short|json` and `--fix` that prints an inline patch.
sara: sample run:
```
./bin/eval-runner preflight --config models/phoenix.yaml --mode=warn --fix
# output: WARN unexpected key eval_timeout (suggestion: timeout)
# patch: models/phoenix.yaml: replace eval_timeout -> timeout
```
ben: also keep exit codes consistent: 0=ok, 1=validation error (non-strict warn), 2=hard error when strict.
dave: update docs + CLI help. people onboarding new models will thank you.
iqra: assigning: ben -> implement flag + suggestions; dave -> CI check patch; sara -> write quick howto snippet for dev docs.
ben: I'll open a small PR and cc @eng-devex.
sara: thanks! will test on local and in CI tomorrow :thumbsup:
